gameDescriptionHtml:
Welcome to Fable Hospital! Enter a world of hospital management like you’ve never seen before. In this hilarious and satirical medieval simulation, you’ll run your own hospital filled with eccentric characters, implausible diseases, and unique challenges.

Immerse yourself in medieval chaos. In Fable Hospital, each day brings new challenges and surprises. Can you manage the chaos of a medieval hospital and keep your patients alive? Or will you find yourself caught in a sea of laughs and disasters?

Game Features

  • Medieval Hospital Management – Manage your medieval hospital and ensure it runs like a well-oiled machine, or at least well enough for patients to survive… most of the time.
  • Unforgettable Characters – Recruit and manage a cast of colorful characters, from the sinister Plague Doctor to the absent-minded Mad Engineer. Each employee has their own set of skills and… quirks.
  • Hilarious Diseases – Treat patients with diseases that defy all logic, from “Lycanthropy” to “Unicorn Syndrome.” Each diagnosis is more absurd than the last!
  • Resources and Agriculture – Step outside the hospital and venture into the countryside to gather herbs, minerals, and other essential resources. Your hospital won’t stock itself!
  • Research and Development – Use alchemy and magic to research new cures and technologies. Unlock upgrades that make your hospital more efficient and hopefully less prone to fires.
  • Humor and Satire – Enjoy dialogues and situations filled with satirical humor. From employees who prefer to have a beer instead of working, to nuns who secretly adore parties, every moment is full of laughs.
  • Charming Art Style – With detailed graphics and an art style that captures the essence of the medieval era, Fable Hospital is a visual delight that complements its clever gameplay.
